A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] was an [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] '''worker''' owned by the [[Rothkar family]], a well-respected family in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The Nikto escaped during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and began [[Death/Legends|killing]] the Rothkars one by one, but was eventually caught.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Vendetta}}</ref>
